        "Describe required action",

        "Assign responsible person",

        "Set due date",

        "Click «Save»",

        "Track implementation",

        "Update status when completed"

      ]

    },


    /* =====================================================
       QUALITY REVIEW
    ===================================================== */

    "Quality Review": {

      icon:
        "📊",

      summaryAr:
        "مراجعة نتائج أهداف الجودة ومؤشرات الأداء ومقارنة النتائج الفعلية بالمستهدف واتخاذ القرارات اللازمة.",

      summaryEn:
        "Review quality goals and performance results against targets and determine necessary actions.",

      stepsAr: [

        "اضغط «مراجعة جودة جديدة»",

        "اختر هدف الجودة",

        "حدد فترة المراجعة",

        "راجع مؤشرات الأداء",

        "أدخل النتائج الفعلية",

        "قارن النتيجة بالمستهدف",

        "أضف الملاحظات والتوصيات",

        "حدد الإجراءات المطلوبة عند الحاجة",

        "اضغط «حفظ»"

      ],

      stepsEn: [

        "Click «New Quality Review»",

        "Select quality goal",

        "Set review period",

        "Review KPIs",

        "Enter actual values",

        "Compare results against targets",

        "Add notes and recommendations",

        "Define required actions if needed",

        "Click «Save»"

      ]

    }

  };


  /* =========================================================
     11. TRANSLATION
  ========================================================= */

  function translate(name) {

    if (!isArabic)
      return name;

    return (
      arabicFallback[name] ||
      (
        typeof window.__ === "function"
          ? window.__(name)
          : name
      )
    );

  }


  function escapeHtml(value) {

    return String(value ?? "")

      .replaceAll("&", "&")

      .replaceAll("<", "<")

      .replaceAll(">", ">")

      .replaceAll('"', """)

      .replaceAll("'", "'");

  }


  function formatNumber(number) {

    return (
      parseFloat(number) || 0
    ).toLocaleString("en-US");

  }


  /* =========================================================
     12. MODAL
  ========================================================= */

  function showInfoModal(data) {

    const title =
      isArabic
        ? data.labelAr
        : data.labelEn;


    const summary =
      isArabic
        ? data.summaryAr
        : data.summaryEn;


    const steps =
      isArabic
        ? data.stepsAr
        : data.stepsEn;


    const hasSteps =
      Array.isArray(steps) &&
      steps.length > 0;


    const showText =
      isArabic
        ? "📖 عرض الخطوات"
        : "📖 Show Steps";


    const hideText =
      isArabic
        ? "📖 إخفاء الخطوات"
        : "📖 Hide Steps";


    const overlay =
      document.createElement("div");


    overlay.className =
      "erp-modal-overlay";


    overlay.setAttribute(
      "dir",
      isArabic ? "rtl" : "ltr"
    );


    overlay.innerHTML = `

      <div class="erp-modal-box">

        <button
          type="button"
          class="erp-modal-close"
          data-modal-close
        >
          ✕
        </button>


        <div class="erp-modal-header">

          <span class="erp-modal-icon">
            ${data.icon || "📄"}
          </span>


          <h3 class="erp-modal-title">
            ${escapeHtml(title)}
          </h3>

        </div>


        <p class="erp-modal-summary">
          ${escapeHtml(summary)}
        </p>


        ${
          hasSteps
            ? `

              <button
                type="button"
                class="erp-modal-toggle-steps"
                data-toggle-steps
              >
                ${showText}
              </button>


              <div
                class="erp-modal-steps"
                data-modal-steps
              >

                <ol class="erp-modal-steps-list">

                  ${steps

                    .map(
                      step =>
                        `<li>${escapeHtml(step)}</li>`
                    )

                    .join("")}

                </ol>

              </div>

            `
            : ""
        }

      </div>

    `;


    root.appendChild(overlay);


    requestAnimationFrame(() => {

      overlay.classList.add(
        "is-visible"
      );

    });


    function closeModal() {

      overlay.remove();

    }


    overlay
      .querySelector(
        "[data-modal-close]"
      )
      ?.addEventListener(
        "click",
        closeModal
      );


    overlay.addEventListener(

      "click",

      event => {

        if (event.target === overlay) {

          closeModal();

        }

      }

    );


    const toggleButton =
      overlay.querySelector(
        "[data-toggle-steps]"
      );


    const stepsContainer =
      overlay.querySelector(
        "[data-modal-steps]"
      );


    if (
      toggleButton &&
      stepsContainer
    ) {

      toggleButton.addEventListener(

        "click",

        () => {

          stepsContainer
            .classList
            .toggle(
              "is-shown"
            );


          toggleButton.textContent =
            stepsContainer
              .classList
              .contains(
                "is-shown"
              )

              ? hideText
              : showText;

        }

      );

    }

  }


  /* =========================================================
     13. ROUTING
  ========================================================= */

  function openRoute(name) {

    if (
      !window.frappe ||
      typeof frappe.set_route !== "function"
    )
      return;


    if (
      reportNames.has(name)
    ) {

      frappe.set_route(
        "query-report",
        name
      );

      return;

    }


    if (
      singleDocs.has(name)
    ) {

      frappe.set_route(
        "Form",
        name
      );

      return;

    }


    if (
      name === "Tree of Procedures"
    ) {

      frappe.set_route(
        "Tree",
        "Quality Procedure"
      );

      return;

    }


    frappe.set_route(
      "List",
      name
    );

  }


  /* =========================================================
     14. RENDER QUALITY CYCLE
  ========================================================= */

  function renderQualityCycle() {

    if (!qualityCycle)
      return;


    const title =
      isArabic
        ? "دورة الجودة"
        : "Quality Cycle";


    qualityCycle.innerHTML = `

      <section class="erp-cycle-container">

        <h2
          class="
            erp-section-title
            erp-cycle-title
          "
        >
          ${escapeHtml(title)}
        </h2>


        <div
          class="erp-cycle-grid"
          style="
            grid-template-columns:
            repeat(
              ${qualityCycleCards.length},
              minmax(0,1fr)
            );
          "
        >

          ${qualityCycleCards

            .map(
              (card, index) => {

                const cardTitle =
                  isArabic
                    ? card.labelAr
                    : card.labelEn;


                const description =
                  isArabic
                    ? card.descriptionAr
                    : card.descriptionEn;


                const arrow =
                  index <
                  qualityCycleCards.length - 1

                    ? `

                      <span
                        class="erp-cycle-arrow"
                        aria-hidden="true"
                      >
                        ${
                          isArabic
                            ? "←"
                            : "→"
                        }
                      </span>

                    `

                    : "";


                return `

                  <div class="erp-cycle-item">

                    <button
                      type="button"
                      class="
                        erp-cycle-card
                        cycle-tone-${(index % 4) + 1}
                      "
                      data-cycle-index="${index}"
                    >

                      <span class="erp-cycle-number">
                        ${card.step}
                      </span>


                      <span class="erp-cycle-card-title">
                        ${escapeHtml(cardTitle)}
                      </span>


                      <span class="erp-cycle-description">
                        ${escapeHtml(description)}
                      </span>

                    </button>


                    ${arrow}

                  </div>

                `;

              }
            )

            .join("")}

        </div>

      </section>

    `;


    qualityCycle.addEventListener(

      "click",

      event => {

        const element =
          event.target.closest(
            "[data-cycle-index]"
          );


        if (!element)
          return;


        const card =
          qualityCycleCards[
            Number(
              element.dataset.cycleIndex
            )
          ];


        if (!card)
          return;


        if (
          card.action === "new"
        ) {

          frappe.new_doc(
            card.doctype
          );

        }

      }

    );

  }


  /* =========================================================
     15. RENDER STATS
  ========================================================= */

  function renderStats() {

    if (!statsSection)
      return;


    statsSection.innerHTML = `

      <section class="erp-overview-container">

        <h2 class="erp-section-title">

          ${
            isArabic
              ? "نظرة عامة"
              : "Overview"
          }

        </h2>


        <div class="erp-stats-grid">

          ${statsCards

            .map(
              (card, index) => `

                <div
                  class="
                    erp-stat-card
                    overview-tone-${index + 1}
                  "
                >

                  <div class="erp-stat-icon">
                    ${escapeHtml(card.short)}
                  </div>


                  <div class="erp-stat-info">

                    <span
                      class="erp-stat-value"
                      data-stat-id="${card.id}"
                    >
                      ...
                    </span>


                    <span class="erp-stat-label">

                      ${escapeHtml(
                        isArabic
                          ? card.labelAr
                          : card.labelEn
                      )}

                    </span>

                  </div>

                </div>

              `
            )

            .join("")}

        </div>

      </section>

    `;


    statsCards.forEach(card => {

      card.fetch()
        .then(value => {

          const element =
            statsSection.querySelector(
              `[data-stat-id="${card.id}"]`
            );


          if (element) {

            element.textContent =
              formatNumber(value);

          }

        });

    });

  }


  /* =========================================================
     16. QUICK ACTIONS
  ========================================================= */

  function renderQuickActions() {

    if (!quickActions)
      return;


    quickActions.innerHTML = `

      <h2 class="erp-section-title">

        ${
          isArabic
            ? "اختصارات سريعة"
            : "Quick Actions"
        }

      </h2>


      <div class="erp-quick-grid">

        ${quickActionButtons

          .map(
            (button, index) => `

              <button
                type="button"
                class="erp-quick-btn"
                data-quick-index="${index}"
              >

                <span class="erp-quick-label">

                  ${escapeHtml(
                    isArabic
                      ? button.labelAr
                      : button.labelEn
                  )}

                </span>

              </button>

            `
          )

          .join("")}

      </div>

    `;


    quickActions.addEventListener(

      "click",

      event => {

        const element =
          event.target.closest(
            "[data-quick-index]"
          );


        if (!element)
          return;


        const button =
          quickActionButtons[
            Number(
              element.dataset.quickIndex
            )
          ];


        if (!button)
          return;


        frappe.new_doc(
          button.doctype
        );

      }

    );

  }


  /* =========================================================
     17. RENDER SECTIONS
  ========================================================= */

  function renderSections() {

    content.innerHTML =
      sections

        .map(
          (section, sectionIndex) => {


            const cards =
              section[1]

                .map(
                  (card, cardIndex) => {


                    const links =
                      card[2]

                        .map(
                          item => {


                            const description =
                              itemDescriptions[item];


                            return `

                              <div class="erp-link-row">

                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  class="erp-link"
                                  data-route-name="${escapeHtml(item)}"
                                >

                                  <span class="erp-link-text">

                                    ${escapeHtml(
                                      translate(item)
                                    )}

                                  </span>


                                  <span class="erp-link-arrow">

                                    ${
                                      isArabic
                                        ? "←"
                                        : "→"
                                    }

                                  </span>

                                </button>


                                ${
                                  description

                                    ? `

                                      <button
                                        type="button"
                                        class="erp-info-link"
                                        data-info-item="${escapeHtml(item)}"
                                      >

                                        ${
                                          isArabic
                                            ? "تفاصيل"
                                            : "Details"
                                        }

                                      </button>

                                    `

                                    : ""
                                }

                              </div>

                            `;

                          }
                        )

                        .join("");


                    return `

                      <article
                        class="
                          erp-card is-open
                          tone-${(sectionIndex + cardIndex) % 5}
                        "
                        data-erp-card
                      >

                        <button
                          type="button"
                          class="erp-card-heading"
                          data-card-toggle
                          aria-expanded="true"
                        >

                          <span class="erp-icon">
                            ${card[1]}
                          </span>


                          <span class="erp-card-title">

                            ${escapeHtml(
                              translate(card[0])
                            )}

                          </span>


                          <span class="erp-card-chevron">
                            ⌄
                          </span>

                        </button>


                        <div class="erp-card-links">
                          ${links}
                        </div>

                      </article>

                    `;

                  }
                )

                .join("");


            return `

              <section class="erp-module-section">

                <h2 class="erp-section-title">

                  ${escapeHtml(
                    translate(section[0])
                  )}

                </h2>


                <div class="erp-dashboard-grid">
                  ${cards}
                </div>

              </section>

            `;

          }
        )

        .join("");

  }


  /* =========================================================
     18. FOOTER
  ========================================================= */

  function renderFooter() {

    if (!footerEl)
      return;


    footerEl.innerHTML = `

      <div class="erp-footer-inner">

        <div class="erp-footer-item">

          <span class="erp-footer-icon">
            ☎
          </span>

          <span class="erp-footer-label">

            ${
              isArabic
                ? footerInfo.labels.phoneAr
                : footerInfo.labels.phoneEn
            }:

          </span>

          <a
            href="tel:${footerInfo.phone}"
            class="erp-footer-link"
            dir="ltr"
          >
            ${footerInfo.phone}
          </a>

        </div>


        <span class="erp-footer-sep">
          |
        </span>


        <div class="erp-footer-item">

          <span class="erp-footer-icon">
            ✉
          </span>

          <span class="erp-footer-label">

            ${
              isArabic
                ? footerInfo.labels.emailAr
                : footerInfo.labels.emailEn
            }:

          </span>

          <a
            href="mailto:${footerInfo.email}"
            class="erp-footer-link"
          >
            ${footerInfo.email}
          </a>

        </div>


        <span class="erp-footer-sep">
          |
        </span>


        <div class="erp-footer-item">

          <span class="erp-footer-icon">
            ◎
          </span>

          <span class="erp-footer-label">

            ${
              isArabic
                ? footerInfo.labels.websiteAr
                : footerInfo.labels.websiteEn
            }:

          </span>

          <a
            href="https://${footerInfo.website}"
            class="erp-footer-link"
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener"
          >
            ${footerInfo.website}
          </a>

        </div>

      </div>

    `;

  }


  /* =========================================================
     19. EVENTS
  ========================================================= */

  let lastToggleTime = 0;


  content.addEventListener(

    "click",

    event => {


      /* DETAILS */

      const infoButton =
        event.target.closest(
          "[data-info-item]"
        );


      if (infoButton) {

        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();


        const itemName =
          infoButton.dataset.infoItem;


        const data =
          itemDescriptions[itemName];


        if (data) {

          showInfoModal({

            ...data,

            labelAr:
              translate(itemName),

            labelEn:
              itemName

          });

        }


        return;

      }


      /* ROUTE */

      const routeButton =
        event.target.closest(
          "[data-route-name]"
        );


      if (routeButton) {

        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();


        openRoute(
          routeButton.dataset.routeName
        );


        return;

      }


      /* CARD */

      const cardButton =
        event.target.closest(
          "[data-card-toggle]"
        );


      if (!cardButton)
        return;


      const now =
        Date.now();


      if (
        now - lastToggleTime < 400
      )
        return;


      lastToggleTime =
        now;


      const selectedCard =
        cardButton.closest(
          "[data-erp-card]"
        );


      if (!selectedCard)
        return;


      const shouldOpen =
        !selectedCard
          .classList
          .contains(
            "is-open"
          );


      content
        .querySelectorAll(
          "[data-erp-card]"
        )
        .forEach(card => {

          if (
            card !== selectedCard
          ) {

            card
              .classList
              .remove(
                "is-open"
              );


            card
              .querySelector(
                "[data-card-toggle]"
              )
              ?.setAttribute(
                "aria-expanded",
                "false"
              );

          }

        });


      selectedCard
        .classList
        .toggle(
          "is-open",
          shouldOpen
        );


      cardButton
        .setAttribute(
          "aria-expanded",
          shouldOpen
            ? "true"
            : "false"
        );

    }

  );


  /* =========================================================
     20. INIT
  ========================================================= */

  renderQualityCycle();

  renderStats();

  renderQuickActions();

  renderSections();

  renderFooter();

})();

(() => {

  const quickActionButtons = [

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════

    ["Data","💾",["Import Data","Export Data","Bulk Update","Download Backups","Deleted Documents"]],
    ["Tools","🛠️",["To Do","Calendar","Note","Files"]],
    ["Alerts and Notifications","🔔",["Notification","Auto Email Report","Notification Settings"]],

    ["Newsletter","📰",["Newsletter","Email Group"]]
  ]]];

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
     ⑤ الترجمة العربية
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  const arabicFallback = {
    "Documents":"المستندات",
    "Data":"البيانات","Tools":"الأدوات","Alerts and Notifications":"التنبيهات والإشعارات","Email":"البريد الإلكتروني","Printing":"الطباعة","Automation":"الأتمتة","Newsletter":"النشرة البريدية",

    "To Do":"المهام","Calendar":"التقويم","Note":"الملاحظات","Files":"الملفات",

  function translate(name) {

    if (!isArabic)
      return name;

    return (
      arabicFallback[name] ||
      (
        typeof window.__ === "function"
          ? window.__(name)
          : name
      )
    );

  }


  function escapeHtml(value) {

    return String(value ?? "")

      .replaceAll("&", "&")

      .replaceAll("<", "<")

      .replaceAll(">", ">")

      .replaceAll('"', """)

      .replaceAll("'", "'");

  }


  function formatNumber(number) {

    return (
      parseFloat(number) || 0
    ).toLocaleString("en-US");

  }

  function showInfoModal(data) {

    const title =
      isArabic
        ? data.labelAr
        : data.labelEn;


    const summary =
      isArabic
        ? data.summaryAr
        : data.summaryEn;


    const steps =
      isArabic
        ? data.stepsAr
        : data.stepsEn;


    const hasSteps =
      Array.isArray(steps) &&
      steps.length > 0;


    const showText =
      isArabic
        ? "📖 عرض الخطوات"
        : "📖 Show Steps";


    const hideText =
      isArabic
        ? "📖 إخفاء الخطوات"
        : "📖 Hide Steps";


    const stepsHtml =
      hasSteps

        ? `
          <div
            class="erp-modal-steps"
            data-modal-steps
          >

            <ol class="erp-modal-steps-list">

              ${steps
                .map(
                  step =>
                    `<li>${escapeHtml(step)}</li>`
                )
                .join("")}

            </ol>

          </div>
        `

        : "";


    const overlay =
      document.createElement("div");


    overlay.className =
      "erp-modal-overlay";


    overlay.setAttribute(
      "dir",
      isArabic ? "rtl" : "ltr"
    );


    overlay.innerHTML = `

      <div class="erp-modal-box">

        <button
          type="button"
          class="erp-modal-close"
          data-modal-close
        >
          ✕
        </button>


        <div class="erp-modal-header">

          <span class="erp-modal-icon">
            ${data.icon}
          </span>

          <h3 class="erp-modal-title">
            ${escapeHtml(title)}
          </h3>

        </div>


        <p class="erp-modal-summary">
          ${escapeHtml(summary)}
        </p>


        ${
          hasSteps

            ? `
              <button
                type="button"
                class="erp-modal-toggle-steps"
                data-toggle-steps
              >
                ${showText}
              </button>
            `

            : ""
        }


        ${stepsHtml}

      </div>

    `;


    root.appendChild(overlay);


    requestAnimationFrame(() => {

      overlay.classList.add(
        "is-visible"
      );

    });


    function closeModal() {

      overlay.classList.remove(
        "is-visible"
      );


      overlay.addEventListener(

        "transitionend",

        () => overlay.remove(),

        {
          once: true
        }

      );

    }


    overlay
      .querySelector("[data-modal-close]")
      .addEventListener(
        "click",
        closeModal
      );


    overlay.addEventListener(

      "click",

      event => {

        if (event.target === overlay)
          closeModal();

      }

    );


    const toggleButton =
      overlay.querySelector(
        "[data-toggle-steps]"
      );


    const stepsContainer =
      overlay.querySelector(
        "[data-modal-steps]"
      );


    if (
      toggleButton &&
      stepsContainer
    ) {

      toggleButton.addEventListener(

        "click",

        () => {

          stepsContainer.classList.toggle(
            "is-shown"
          );


          toggleButton.textContent =
            stepsContainer.classList.contains(
              "is-shown"
            )

              ? hideText
              : showText;

        }

      );

    }

  }

  function openRoute(name) {

    if (
      !window.frappe ||
      typeof frappe.set_route !== "function"
    )
      return;


    if (reportNames.has(name)) {

      frappe.set_route(
        "query-report",
        name
      );

      return;

    }


    if (singleDocs.has(name)) {

      frappe.set_route(
        "Form",
        name
      );

      return;

    }


    if (treeDocs.has(name)) {

      frappe.set_route(
        "Tree",
        name
      );

      return;

    }


    frappe.set_route(
      "List",
      name
    );

  }

  function renderSalesCycle() {

    if (!salesCycle)
      return;


    const sectionTitle =
      isArabic
        ? "دورة المبيعات"
        : "Sales Cycle";


    salesCycle.innerHTML = `

      <section class="erp-cycle-container">

        <h2 class="erp-section-title erp-cycle-title">
          ${escapeHtml(sectionTitle)}
        </h2>


        <div class="erp-cycle-grid">

          ${salesCycleCards

            .map(
              (card, index) => {

                const title =
                  isArabic
                    ? card.labelAr
                    : card.labelEn;


                const description =
                  isArabic
                    ? card.descriptionAr
                    : card.descriptionEn;


                const arrow =
                  index <
                  salesCycleCards.length - 1

                    ? `
                      <span
                        class="erp-cycle-arrow"
                        aria-hidden="true"
                      >
                        ${isArabic ? "←" : "→"}
                      </span>
                    `

                    : "";


                return `

                  <div class="erp-cycle-item">

                    <button
                      type="button"
                      class="
                        erp-cycle-card
                        cycle-tone-${(index % 4) + 1}
                      "
                      data-cycle-route="${escapeHtml(card.doctype)}"
                    >

                      <span class="erp-cycle-number">
                        ${card.step}
                      </span>


                      <span class="erp-cycle-card-title">
                        ${escapeHtml(title)}
                      </span>


                      <span class="erp-cycle-description">
                        ${escapeHtml(description)}
                      </span>

                    </button>


                    ${arrow}

                  </div>

                `;

              }
            )

            .join("")}

        </div>

      </section>

    `;


    salesCycle.addEventListener(

      "click",

      event => {

        const card =
          event.target.closest(
            "[data-cycle-route]"
          );


        if (!card)
          return;


        event.preventDefault();


        openRoute(
          card.dataset.cycleRoute
        );

      }

    );

  }

      <section class="erp-overview-container">

        <h2 class="erp-section-title">
          ${escapeHtml(title)}
        </h2>


        <div class="erp-stats-grid">

          ${statsCards

            .map(
              (card, index) => `

                <div
                  class="
                    erp-stat-card
                    overview-tone-${index + 1}
                  "
                >

                  <div class="erp-stat-icon">
                    ${escapeHtml(card.short)}
                  </div>


                  <div class="erp-stat-info">

                    <span
                      class="erp-stat-value"
                      data-stat-id="${card.id}"
                    >
                      ...
                    </span>


                    <span class="erp-stat-label">

                      ${escapeHtml(
                        isArabic
                          ? card.labelAr
                          : card.labelEn
                      )}

                    </span>

                  </div>

                </div>

              `
            )

            .join("")}

        </div>

      </section>

    `;


    if (!window.frappe)
      return;


    statsCards.forEach(card => {

      card.fetch().then(value => {

        const element =
          statsSection.querySelector(
            `[data-stat-id="${card.id}"]`
          );


        if (element) {

          element.textContent =
            formatNumber(value);

        }

      });

    });

  }


  /* =========================================================
     15. QUICK ACTIONS
  ========================================================= */

  function renderQuickActions() {

    if (!quickActions)
      return;


    quickActions.innerHTML = `

      <h2 class="erp-section-title">

        ${escapeHtml(
          isArabic
            ? "اختصارات سريعة"
            : "Quick Actions"
        )}

      </h2>


      <div class="erp-quick-grid">

        ${quickActionButtons

          .map(
            button => `

              <button
                type="button"
                class="erp-quick-btn"
                data-new-doc="${escapeHtml(button.doctype)}"
              >

                <span class="erp-quick-label">

                  ${escapeHtml(
                    isArabic
                      ? button.labelAr
                      : button.labelEn
                  )}

                </span>

              </button>

            `
          )

          .join("")}

      </div>

    `;


    quickActions.addEventListener(

      "click",

      event => {

        const button =
          event.target.closest(
            "[data-new-doc]"
          );


        if (
          !button ||
          !window.frappe
        )
          return;


        if (
          typeof frappe.new_doc ===
          "function"
        ) {

          frappe.new_doc(
            button.dataset.newDoc
          );

        }

      }

    );

  }


  /* =========================================================
     16. RENDER SECTIONS
  ========================================================= */

  function renderSections() {

    content.innerHTML =
      sections

        .map(
          (section, sectionIndex) => {


            const cards =
              section[1]

                .map(
                  (card, cardIndex) => {


                    const links =
                      card[2]

                        .map(
                          item => {


                            const description =
                              itemDescriptions[item];


                            const detailText =
                              isArabic
                                ? "تفاصيل"
                                : "Details";


                            const infoButton =
                              description

                                ? `
                                  <button
                                    type="button"
                                    class="erp-info-link"
                                    data-info-item="${escapeHtml(item)}"
                                  >
                                    ${detailText}
                                  </button>
                                `

                                : "";


                            return `

                              <div class="erp-link-row">

                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  class="erp-link"
                                  data-route-name="${escapeHtml(item)}"
                                >

                                  <span class="erp-link-text">
                                    ${escapeHtml(translate(item))}
                                  </span>


                                  <span class="erp-link-arrow">
                                    ${isArabic ? "←" : "→"}
                                  </span>

                                </button>


                                ${infoButton}

                              </div>

                            `;

                          }
                        )

                        .join("");


                    return `

                      <article
                        class="
                          erp-card is-open
                          tone-${(sectionIndex + cardIndex) % 5}
                        "
                        data-erp-card
                      >

                        <button
                          type="button"
                          class="erp-card-heading"
                          data-card-toggle
                          aria-expanded="true"
                        >

                          <span class="erp-icon">
                            ${card[1]}
                          </span>


                          <span class="erp-card-title">
                            ${escapeHtml(translate(card[0]))}
                          </span>


                          <span class="erp-card-chevron">
                            ⌄
                          </span>

                        </button>


                        <div class="erp-card-links">
                          ${links}
                        </div>

                      </article>

                    `;

                  }
                )

                .join("");


            return `

              <section class="erp-module-section">

                <h2 class="erp-section-title">
                  ${escapeHtml(translate(section[0]))}
                </h2>


                <div class="erp-dashboard-grid">
                  ${cards}
                </div>

              </section>

            `;

          }
        )

        .join("");

  }


  /* =========================================================
     17. FOOTER
  ========================================================= */

  function renderFooter() {

    if (!footerEl)
      return;


    const labels =
      footerInfo.labels;


    footerEl.innerHTML = `

      <div class="erp-footer-inner">

        <div class="erp-footer-item">

          <span class="erp-footer-icon">
            ☎
          </span>

          <span class="erp-footer-label">
            ${escapeHtml(
              isArabic
                ? labels.phoneAr
                : labels.phoneEn
            )}:
          </span>

          <a
            href="tel:${footerInfo.phone}"
            class="erp-footer-link"
            dir="ltr"
          >
            ${escapeHtml(footerInfo.phone)}
          </a>

        </div>


        <span class="erp-footer-sep">
          |
        </span>


        <div class="erp-footer-item">

          <span class="erp-footer-icon">
            ✉
          </span>

          <span class="erp-footer-label">
            ${escapeHtml(
              isArabic
                ? labels.emailAr
                : labels.emailEn
            )}:
          </span>

          <a
            href="mailto:${footerInfo.email}"
            class="erp-footer-link"
          >
            ${escapeHtml(footerInfo.email)}
          </a>

        </div>


        <span class="erp-footer-sep">
          |
        </span>


        <div class="erp-footer-item">

          <span class="erp-footer-icon">
            ◎
          </span>

          <span class="erp-footer-label">
            ${escapeHtml(
              isArabic
                ? labels.websiteAr
                : labels.websiteEn
            )}:
          </span>

          <a
            href="https://${footerInfo.website}"
            class="erp-footer-link"
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener"
          >
            ${escapeHtml(footerInfo.website)}
          </a>

        </div>

      </div>

    `;

  }


  /* =========================================================
     18. EVENTS
  ========================================================= */

  let lastToggleTime = 0;


  content.addEventListener(

    "click",

    event => {


      const infoButton =
        event.target.closest(
          "[data-info-item]"
        );


      if (infoButton) {

        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();


        const itemName =
          infoButton.dataset.infoItem;


        const data =
          itemDescriptions[itemName];


        if (data) {

          showInfoModal({

            icon:
              data.icon || "📄",

            labelAr:
              translate(itemName),

            labelEn:
              itemName,

            summaryAr:
              data.summaryAr,

            summaryEn:
              data.summaryEn,

            stepsAr:
              data.stepsAr,

            stepsEn:
              data.stepsEn

          });

        }


        return;

      }


      const routeButton =
        event.target.closest(
          "[data-route-name]"
        );


      if (routeButton) {

        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();


        openRoute(
          routeButton.dataset.routeName
        );


        return;

      }


      const cardButton =
        event.target.closest(
          "[data-card-toggle]"
        );


      if (!cardButton)
        return;


      const now =
        Date.now();


      if (
        now - lastToggleTime <
        400
      )
        return;


      lastToggleTime =
        now;


      const selectedCard =
        cardButton.closest(
          "[data-erp-card]"
        );


      if (!selectedCard)
        return;

      const isOpen =
        selectedCard.classList.contains("is-open");

      if (isOpen) {
        selectedCard.classList.remove("is-open");
        selectedCard.classList.add("is-collapsed");
        cardButton.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
      } else {
        selectedCard.classList.add("is-open");
        selectedCard.classList.remove("is-collapsed");
        cardButton.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
      }
    }

  );


  /* =========================================================
     19. INIT
  ========================================================= */

  renderSalesCycle();

  renderStats();

  renderQuickActions();

  renderSections();

  renderFooter();

})();
